You are performing the single SCOPED RE-REVIEW of the final fix wave. Verdict each finding ADDRESSED or NOT ADDRESSED and flag new breakage in the fix diff only. Do not review code outside this fix diff. There is no further fix round after this.

Working directory: c:\Users\leont\Desktop\CleaningSystem-main

Files to read:
1. The fix diff under review: .superpowers/sdd/2026-08-28-cleaning-site-redesign/review-3a73b5f..0223c8d.diff
2. The implementer's report: .superpowers/sdd/2026-08-28-cleaning-site-redesign/final-fix-report.md

CONTEXT: this is a completed visual redesign of a static vanilla-JS site. css/components.css is ~1257 lines in six appended layers. The fix wave addressed four findings from the whole-branch review. Scope was css/components.css ONLY.

FINDINGS TO VERDICT:

FINDING 1 (Important) — the bare `:focus-visible` rule carried `border-radius: var(--r-sm)`. At specificity (0,1,0) and positioned after `.tab-btn { border-radius: var(--r-pill) }` and `.modal-close { border-radius: 50% }` (both also (0,1,0)), it won on source order and destroyed those two shapes on keyboard focus.
  Required: `border-radius` deleted from the bare `:focus-visible` rule; `outline` and `outline-offset` retained.
  Verify the rule now contains exactly those two declarations, and confirm `.tab-btn` still has `border-radius: var(--r-pill)` and `.modal-close` still has `border-radius: 50%`.

FINDING 2 (Important) — five interactive targets were below the spec's 44px minimum ("Interactive targets at least 44px in their smallest dimension").
  Required: `.btn-card` min-height 38px→44px; `.tab-btn` min-height 40px→44px; `.modal-close` width and height 38px→44px; `header nav a` given `display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 13px`; `.lang-select` given `min-height: 44px` with padding `0 10px`.
  CRITICAL ARITHMETIC CHECK: the header must NOT have grown. `header nav` has vertical padding of var(--s3) = 12px top and bottom. With a 44px link that is 44 + 24 = 68px, which must still equal `--header-h: 68px`, the min-height on `.header-container`. Confirm `--header-h` is still 68px and was not edited. If the nav's vertical padding was changed, redo this arithmetic and report the real resulting height.

FINDING 3 (Minor) — `.contacts-info :focus-visible` was a dead selector (that container renders only h3 and p/strong — no focusable element).
  Required: ONLY that line removed from the grouped rule. `header :focus-visible` and `.price-card.featured :focus-visible` must both remain — the featured price card genuinely contains an `<a class="btn-primary">`.

FINDING 4 (Minor) — `header nav` had `padding: var(--s3) 0` (zero horizontal) with `overflow-x: auto`, clipping the first link's focus ring.
  Required: padding changed to `var(--s3) var(--s1)`.

NEW-BREAKAGE CHECK — these must all still hold:
- The fix diff touches ONLY css/components.css. Confirm from the diff's file list.
- REGRESSION RISK FROM FINDING 2d: `header nav a` gained `display: inline-flex`. Check the sibling rules it interacts with. `header nav a.btn-nav` has `margin-left: var(--s2)`; `header nav > *` has `flex: none` and `scroll-snap-align: end`; `header nav` is itself a flex row with `overflow-x: auto`. Confirm nothing in the new declarations conflicts — in particular that the links are still flex ITEMS of the nav (inline-flex changes their inner formatting context, not their outer role) and that the anchors' padding change from `9px 13px` to `0 13px` cannot collapse their height now that min-height is set.
- Exactly four `!important` declarations, all inside @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce). No fifth anywhere.
- `.portfolio-modal` must still have NO `display` declaration; `.before-img` no `width`; `.slider-handle` no `left`. js/pages/portfolio.js writes those three at runtime and CSS there silently breaks the before/after comparison slider. (`.slider-handle::after` legitimately has `left: 50%` — different box, not a defect.)
- Braces balanced.
- No user-facing text changed; no .js file, index.html, scripts/, or frontend/ touched.
- No rule reordered or deleted beyond the two lines the findings called for.
- The responsive blocks (@media max-width 900px and 640px) and the reduced-motion block must still be the last things in the file, in that order.

RUN IT YOURSELF: `bash scripts/verify-redesign.sh; echo "EXIT=$?"` → expect 10/10 PASS, exit 0.

Report:
- Each finding (1, 2, 3, 4): ADDRESSED or NOT ADDRESSED, with file:line evidence.
- New breakage: list any, labelled Critical / Important / Minor, or "none".
- Overall verdict.
Be concrete. This is the last gate before the branch is offered for merge.

That's a grouped selector (`.btn-primary, .btn-secondary, .btn-card { display: inline-flex; ... }`) plus a separate `.btn-card { min-height: 44px; ... }` block for card-specific overrides — pre-existing pattern, not a duplicate-selector violation, and outside the diff. Confirmed fine.

All verification complete. Here is the scoped re-review report.

## Findings verdicts

**Finding 1 — ADDRESSED.** `css/components.css:1183-1186`: bare `:focus-visible` now contains exactly `outline: 2px solid var(--accent);` and `outline-offset: 2px;` — `border-radius` removed. Confirmed `.tab-btn` (line 562, block starts 561) still has `border-radius: var(--r-pill)` further down in its rule, and `.modal-close` (line 837) still has `border-radius: 50%` in its rule. Shapes are no longer overridden on keyboard focus.

**Finding 2 — ADDRESSED**, all five sub-items, and the arithmetic holds.
- `.btn-card` (`css/components.css:355`): `min-height: 44px`. Confirmed.
- `.tab-btn` (`css/components.css:562`): `min-height: 44px`. Confirmed.
- `.modal-close` (`css/components.css:841-842`): `width: 44px; height: 44px;`. Confirmed.
- `header nav a` (`css/components.css:221-232`): now `display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 13px;` plus untouched declarations.
- `.lang-select` (`css/components.css:258-261`): `min-height: 44px;` with `padding: 0 10px` — confirmed via diff (`8px 10px` → `0 10px`).
- **Header-height arithmetic verified independently**: `--header-h: 68px` (line 72) appears once and is unedited (not in the diff). `header nav` padding is `var(--s3) var(--s1)` — vertical component still `var(--s3)`, only horizontal changed (Finding 4), so vertical padding is unchanged. `.header-container` still has `min-height: var(--header-h)` (line 178). 44px link + top/bottom `var(--s3)` = 68px = `--header-h`. Header has not grown.
- Zero remaining `38px`/`40px` min-heights (confirmed by implementer's grep output and independently by inspecting each target rule).

**Finding 3 — ADDRESSED.** `css/components.css:1187-1191`: grouped rule is now `header :focus-visible, .price-card.featured :focus-visible { outline-color: var(--accent-on-ink); }` — the `.contacts-info :focus-visible` line is gone. `grep -n "contacts-info"` shows no `:focus-visible` occurrence anywhere in the file; `.contacts-info` itself (h3/p/strong rules) is untouched. Both required selectors (`header`, `.price-card.featured`) remain intact.

**Finding 4 — ADDRESSED.** `css/components.css:203`: `header nav` padding is now `var(--s3) var(--s1)` (was `var(--s3) 0`), matching the diff exactly.

## New-breakage check

- **Scope**: diff touches only `css/components.css` (single file in diff header, single `M` in git status). Confirmed.
- **Finding 2d regression risk**: checked sibling rules. `header nav > *` still applies `flex: none; scroll-snap-align: end;` to the anchors as flex items of `header nav` — `inline-flex` on `header nav a` only changes the anchor's *inner* formatting context for its own content, not its outer participation as a flex item of the nav, so this is not a conflict. `header nav a.btn-nav` (line 245) only adds `margin-left`, `background-color`, `color`, `box-shadow` — no `padding`/`height` override, so it inherits the new `padding: 0 13px` and `min-height: 44px` cleanly, no collapse. With `align-items: center` on both `header nav` (outer) and `header nav a` (inner, via inline-flex) and `min-height: 44px` explicitly set on the anchor itself, the `0 13px` padding cannot collapse the link's height — `min-height` is a hard floor independent of padding. No conflict found.
- **`!important` count**: exactly 4, all inside `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)` (lines 1246-1249). No fifth anywhere in the file.
- **Runtime-owned properties**: `.portfolio-modal` (line 801) has no `display` declaration; `.before-img` (line 894) has only `border-right`, no `width`; `.slider-handle` (line 923) has no `left` (only `.slider-handle::after` has `left: 50%`, a different box). All three untouched by the diff and still safe for `js/pages/portfolio.js` to control at runtime.
- **Braces balanced**: verify script reports 170/170 PASS.
- **No user-facing text / no non-CSS files touched**: diff contains only `css/components.css`, confirmed by diff file list.
- **No extraneous reordering/deletion**: diff shows only the two required line removals (Finding 1's `border-radius` line, Finding 3's `.contacts-info :focus-visible` line) plus the five Finding-2/4 property edits — nothing else moved or deleted.
- **Block ordering**: tail of file shows `@media (max-width: 900px)` → `@media (max-width: 640px)` → `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)` as the last three blocks, in that order. Confirmed.

New breakage: **none** (Critical/Important/Minor — none found).
